verses.3017: hadhihi hadiyatu bifaḍli llāhi minnā ʾi layka yā rasūla llāhi
verses.3018: jazā llāhu ʿannānabiyyanā wa sayyidanā wa ḥabībanā wa shafīʿanā wa mawlānā muḥammadā ṣallā llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa sallama mā huwa ʾahluhu
verses.3019: jazā llāhu ʿannā shaykhanā wa ssidanā wa murabbiyanā wa wad-danā l-ḥāji mālik sih raḍiyā llāhu taʿālā ʿanhu wa raḍūhu ʿannā bihi ʾāmīn
verses.3020: wa raḍiyā llāhu ʿan shaykhī t-tijāni wa man lanā ʾilayhi wasīlu kāshifu l-ghumami
verses.3021: wa man taʿʿalaqa bil-ʾadhyāli qāṭibaha ṣubba ʿalaynā ʾilāhī ʾabḥura l-ʿiṣami
verses.3022: wa kulli man ṭalabū ṣāliḥa daʿwatinā wa ghayrihimi min dhawī l-ʾīmāni kullihimi
verses.3023: fāqbal ʾilayhi yā raḥmānu tawbatanā bil-faḍli wa l-jūdi wa r-riḍwāni wa l-karami
verses.3024: kadhā ʾuṣūlī wa ʾaḥbābī ʾuṣulihimu ʿammimhumu rabbī taʿmīmā bidhī l-ḥikami
verses.3025: wa man lanā muḥsanu wa man nusīʾu lahu yā rabbanā rabbanā yā wāsiʿa r-ruḥumi
verses.3026: wamā nuʾaddī min l-ʾadhkāri jumlatihā fāqbal lanā bihimi yā fārija l-himami
verses.3027: ʾalā yā rasūla llāhi yā ʾafḍala l-warā fahā naḥnu fī ḍīqi shadīdi t-tarākumi
verses.3028: fahā naḥnu fī ḍīqi wa lam narju fārijā siwā llāhu wa l-hādī lisubuli l-makārimi
verses.3029: ṣadaqta ʿalā mā qulta fī ʿawdi dīninā gharībā kamā fī l-badʾi yā khayra rāḥimi
verses.3030: ʾilāhiyā fājʿal ʾahlanā ʾahla ghurbahi wa ʾahla ttibāʿi ssunnati fī t-tarāḥumi
verses.3031: naghghuḍu ʿalayhā bin-nawājidhi mithla mā bihi qāla fī l-ʾīṣāʾi naḍrtu hāshimi
verses.3032: naʿūdhu billāhi min sharri l-kufāri wa min sharri n-naṣārā wa min sharri s-salāṭīni
verses.3033: wa min wazīri wa jinni thumma dhī ḥiqadi fammi wa ʿayni wa ʿīni wa sh-shiyāṭīni
verses.3034: wa ẓalimi wa munāfiqi wa dhī ḥasadi wa tafassaqa yā raḥmānu najjīnī
verses.3035: min n-naṣāra wa man qafā ṭaribqahumu yā llāhu yā ḥayyū yā man qāla ʾadʿūnī
verses.3036: ʾinnī daʿawtuka dhā khawfi fakhudh biyadī yā jāʿila l-ḥāli bayna l-kāfi wa n-nūni
verses.3037: yā rabbanā bil-majdi wal-bahāʾi wadh-dhāti waṣ-ṣifāti wal-ʾasmāʾi
verses.3038: yā rabbanā wa l-ʾarḍi was-samāʾi wamā bihā yā mālika l-ʾashyāʾi
verses.3039: ʾalḥiq jamāʿatī bihaʾulāʾi bikhīrati l-ʾakhyāri l-anbiyāʾi
verses.3040: wakun ḥijābā baynanā yā rabbanā wabayna ʿādīnā l-gharūra rabbanā
verses.3041: wāqbal lanā bil-faḍli war-riḍwāni mulbisanā biḥulali l-ghufrāni
verses.3042: wārḥam jamīʿanā wawālidīnā yā rabbanā rabbi wa muslimīnā
verses.3043: yā rabbanā bil-fātiḥi l-miftāḥi nawwir lanā ṣ-ṣudūra bil-miṣbāḥi
verses.3044: waṣalliyan wasallimanna ʿalā n-nabī waʾālihi dhawī l-hudā war-rutabi
verses.3045: wākhtim lanā yā rabbanā bil-khātimi khātimaha ḥusnā ʾilaha l-ʿālami
verses.3046: waṣalliyan wasalliman taslīmā ʿalayhi wāshmil ʾālahu taʿmīmā
verses.3047: ʾanṣur lanā yā rabbanā bin-nāṣiri sirājika l-munīri dhī l-māʾāthiri
verses.3048: waṣalliyan wasalliman ʿalā l-wakīl waʾalihi waṣaḥbihi dhawī l-ʿuqūl
verses.3049: yā rabbi bil-hādī hdinā ʾilā l-hudā wāqbal lanā matābanā ḥaythu badā
verses.3050: waṣalliyan wasalliman ʿalā l-mujīb wal-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi yā rabbī l-qarīb
verses.3051: waffiq lanā yā rabbanā s-sadādā biʾālihi waʾaʿṭinā l-murādā
verses.3052: waṣalliyan wasalliman ʿalā l-karīm wal-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi ʾanjumi n-nujūm
verses.3053: bijāhihi waqadrihi l-ʿaẓīmi qinā ʾilahī sharara l-jaḥīmi
verses.3054: waṣalliyan wasalliman ʿalā sh-shafīʿ wal-ʾāli wa l-ʾaṣḥābi rabbanā r-rafīʿ
